description: Header file defining inline functions to wrap various tensor operation outputs and other data types as PyObject* for Python interoperability in PyTorch autograd utils.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Converts various data types (bool, int, double, complex, tensor, scalar, device index, layout, qscheme, tensor list, int array, stream, tuple) into PyObject* for Python interoperability.

methods.name: apply_with_idx
methods.description: Applies a function to each element of a tuple with its index, used internally for wrapping tuple elements.

methods.name: apply_with_idx_impl
methods.description: Helper template function to implement indexed application of a function over tuple elements.
